answer: Agents anchor one forge to a quartz crystal with a 60-credit bond, burning 12 credits each epoch. A random beacon spot-checks 10% each epoch; checked forges show a quartz heartbeat log, and a cold or shared forge loses its bond. Rented forges fail: one crystal signs one log. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits and burn 12,000 fuel per epoch for 8 credits each, a 4,000 loss per epoch. An honest agent runs one forge, pays 12 fuel, keeps its reward.
